content.title: Ads-Tec Energy selected by Q8 to supply ultra-fast chargers
content.summary: ADS-TEC Energy (ADSE) announced that Q8 has selected ADS-TEC Energy as its supplier for battery-integrated ultra-fast chargers, marking a significant step forward in the expansion of electric vehicle infrastructure across Belgium and the Netherlands. Under the terms of a recently awarded tender, ADS-TEC Energy will deliver more than a dozen ChargePost and ChargeBox systems to Q8 and Tango service stations, enabling ultra-fast charging even in areas with limited grid capacity caused by net conges

content.title: Ads-Tec Energy price target raised to $18 from $14 at Roth MKM, buy on weakness
content.summary: Roth MKM raised the firm’s price target on Ads-Tec Energy (ADSE) to $18 from $14 and keeps a Neutral rating on the shares. Ads-Tec’s preliminary results for the second half of 2024 point to rising business momentum heading into 2026 with an expanded business model and proactive customer solutions to mitigate risks and resolve revenue stickiness issues, the analyst tells investors in a research note. The firm recommends opportunistically buying shares on any weakness. Published first on TheFly –
